project.name: JOSESwift
project.description: A modular and extensible framework for the JOSE standards (JWS, JWE, JWK) written in Swift.

nodes.name: config.yml
nodes.summary: CircleCI CI/CD pipeline running on macOS M1 executors with Xcode 15.4. Defines four jobs: prepare-build (dependency caching), test (fastlane test), lint (SwiftFormat + SwiftLint), and sonarcloud (SonarQube analysis).
nodes.languageNotes: Uses CircleCI orbs for macOS Ruby version switching and workspace persistence to share build artifacts between jobs.

nodes.name: CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md
nodes.summary: Contributor Covenant Code of Conduct (v1.4) defining community standards, enforcement guidelines, and scope for the JOSESwift project.

nodes.name: CONTRIBUTING.md
nodes.summary: Contribution guide outlining the code of conduct, how to contribute, the pull request process, and general expectations for contributors to JOSESwift.

nodes.name: renovate.json
nodes.summary: Renovate bot configuration enabling recommended defaults with auto-merge for minor, patch, and lock file maintenance updates.

nodes.name: .ruby-version
nodes.summary: Pin file specifying the Ruby version used by the project's CI pipeline and local development environment.

nodes.name: .swift-version
nodes.summary: Pin file specifying the Swift compiler version used across the project's build and CI toolchain.

nodes.name: .swiftformat
nodes.summary: SwiftFormat configuration file controlling automatic code formatting rules for the JOSESwift codebase.

nodes.name: .swiftlint.yml
nodes.summary: SwiftLint configuration that excludes vendor and build directories, enables only custom rules (essentially a no-op lint pass used for SonarQube report generation).

nodes.name: Empty.swift
nodes.summary: Empty placeholder Swift file required by the Swift Package Manager for the BuildTools package target.

nodes.name: Package.resolved
nodes.summary: Resolved dependency manifest for the BuildTools SPM package, pinning exact versions of SwiftFormat and SwiftLint plugins.

nodes.name: Package.swift
nodes.summary: Swift Package Manager manifest declaring the BuildTools package with dependencies on SwiftFormat and SwiftLintPlugins, targeting macOS 14.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses swift-tools-version:5.10 and SPM package plugins for integrating SwiftFormat and SwiftLint into the build process.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Brief documentation explaining how to resolve and update build tool dependencies (SwiftFormat, SwiftLint) via the BuildTools SPM package.

nodes.name: CHANGELOG.md
nodes.summary: Release history spanning versions 1.4.0 through 3.0.0, documenting feature additions, bug fixes, and contributor acknowledgments for each release.

nodes.name: Fastfile
nodes.summary: Fastlane automation defining lanes for testing, SwiftFormat/SwiftLint linting with SonarQube report conversion, version bumping, release preparation, CocoaPods trunk publishing, and GitHub release creation.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Fastlane's Ruby DSL with lanes for test, lint, bump, prepare, release, and sonarqube workflows. Generates SonarQube-compatible JSON reports from both SwiftFormat and SwiftLint output.

nodes.name: Gemfile
nodes.summary: Ruby gem dependencies including CocoaPods, Fastlane, xcpretty, and rb-readline used for build automation and release management.

nodes.name: JOSESwift.podspec
nodes.summary: CocoaPods podspec for JOSESwift 3.0.0, targeting iOS 13+, macOS 10.15+, watchOS 8+, tvOS 15+, and visionOS 1.0 with Swift 5.0.

nodes.name: project.pbxproj
nodes.summary: Xcode project file defining the JOSESwift framework target, test target, build settings, file references, and build phases for the entire project.

nodes.name: contents.xcworkspacedata
nodes.summary: Xcode workspace data file referencing the project within the xcworkspace container.

nodes.name: JOSESwift.xcscheme
nodes.summary: Xcode build scheme for the JOSESwift framework target, configuring build, test, profile, and analyze actions.

nodes.name: Tests.xcscheme
nodes.summary: Xcode build scheme dedicated to running the JOSESwift test suite with configured test action.

nodes.name: contents.xcworkspacedata
nodes.summary: Root Xcode workspace data file that groups the JOSESwift Xcode project for unified development.

nodes.name: IDEWorkspaceChecks.plist
nodes.summary: Xcode workspace checks plist tracking IDE state for the JOSESwift workspace.

nodes.name: AlgorithmExtensions.swift
nodes.summary: Swift extensions on JOSE algorithm enums providing computed properties for key lengths, initialization vector lengths, HMAC algorithm mapping, and PBES2 derived key lengths.

nodes.name: Algorithms.swift
nodes.summary: Core algorithm definitions for JOSE standards: defines public enums for signature algorithms (HS256-512, RS256-512, PS256-512, ES256-512), key management algorithms (RSA, AES-KW, ECDH, PBES2), content encryption algorithms (AES-CBC-HMAC, AES-GCM), HMAC algorithms, JWK thumbprint, and compression algorithms.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Swift enums with raw String values to model JOSE algorithm identifiers from RFC 7518. Computed properties provide algorithm-specific parameters like key sizes and tag lengths.

nodes.name: ASN1DEREncoding.swift
nodes.summary: Internal ASN.1 DER encoding helpers providing TLV (Tag-Length-Value) triplet construction for UInt8 arrays, used to encode cryptographic keys and signatures in DER format.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Swift extensions on Array<UInt8> to add ASN.1 DER encoding capability. The lengthField helper handles both short-form (single byte) and long-form (multi-byte) length encoding per ASN.1 rules.

nodes.name: test
nodes.summary: Fastlane lane that cleans derived data and runs the JOSESwift test suite via scan with a clean build.

nodes.name: lint
nodes.summary: Fastlane lane that runs both SwiftFormat and SwiftLint checks in sequence.

nodes.name: lint_swiftformat
nodes.summary: Fastlane lane that runs SwiftFormat in lint mode and converts the JSON report to SonarQube-compatible format.

nodes.name: lint_swiftlint
nodes.summary: Fastlane lane that runs SwiftLint via SPM plugin and post-processes the SonarQube report to clean file paths.

nodes.name: bump
nodes.summary: Fastlane lane that bumps the version number in both Xcode project and podspec, supporting major/minor/patch or explicit version strings.

nodes.name: prepare
nodes.summary: Fastlane lane that orchestrates release preparation: ensures clean git state on master, bumps version, creates a release branch, formats code, updates copyright, runs tests, and pushes the release branch.

nodes.name: release
nodes.summary: Fastlane lane that performs the final release: tags the version in git, pushes tags, publishes to CocoaPods trunk, and creates a GitHub release.

nodes.name: sonarqube
nodes.summary: Fastlane lane that converts Xcode coverage reports to SonarQube generic format and runs SonarQube analysis.

nodes.name: ASN1DERParsing.swift
nodes.summary: Provides ASN.1 DER encoding parsing utilities, including TLV triplet extraction, for reading and skipping ASN.1 types like sequences and integers from byte arrays. Used by EC signature conversion to translate between DER and raw JWS signature formats.

nodes.name: DataConvertible.swift
nodes.summary: Defines the DataConvertible protocol that enables lossless bidirectional conversion between Data and conforming types. Serves as the foundation for JOSE component serialization and deserialization throughout the framework.

nodes.name: DataExtensions.swift
nodes.summary: Extends Data with Base64URL encoding/decoding, octet-hex byte length conversion, and constant-time comparison for cryptographic safety. Also conforms Data to DataConvertible.

nodes.name: timingSafeCompare
nodes.summary: Compares two Data buffers in constant time to prevent timing side-channel attacks, using the platform's timingsafe_bcmp on iOS 10.1+ or a manual XOR-based fallback.

nodes.name: Deserializer.swift
nodes.summary: Implements compact JOSE deserialization with the JOSEDeserializer struct and supporting protocols. Defines ComponentCompactSerializedIndex with standard index constants for JWS and JWE component positions.

nodes.name: JOSEHeader.swift
nodes.summary: Defines the JOSEHeader protocol with JSON parameter storage, validation, and DataConvertible conformance. Specifies the CommonHeaderParameterSpace protocol for shared JWS/JWE header parameters like kid, typ, and cty.

nodes.name: JOSESwiftError.swift
nodes.summary: Central error enum for the JOSESwift framework covering signing, verification, encryption, decryption, data encoding, key coding, compression, thumbprint computation, header validation, and algorithm mismatch errors.

nodes.name: Payload.swift
nodes.summary: Wraps a Data buffer as a DataConvertible Payload struct with optional compression support via CompressorFactory. Serves as the primary data container for JWS and JWE content.

nodes.name: Serializer.swift
nodes.summary: Implements compact JOSE serialization through the JOSESerializer struct and supporting protocols. Serializes CompactSerializable objects into dot-separated Base64URL-encoded strings.

nodes.name: AES.swift
nodes.summary: Provides AES-CBC encryption/decryption and AES key wrap/unwrap operations using Apple's CommonCrypto framework. Supports 128/192/256-bit key sizes for both content encryption and key management algorithms.

nodes.name: encrypt
nodes.summary: Encrypts plaintext using AES-CBC with the specified content encryption algorithm and initialization vector, dispatching to the low-level ccAESCBCCrypt helper.

nodes.name: decrypt
nodes.summary: Decrypts AES-CBC ciphertext using the specified content encryption algorithm and initialization vector, delegating to the low-level ccAESCBCCrypt helper.

nodes.name: ccAESCBCCrypt
nodes.summary: Low-level AES-CBC cryptographic operation wrapper around CommonCrypto's CCCrypt function, handling buffer allocation and PKCS7 padding.

nodes.name: wrap
nodes.summary: Encrypts a raw key using AES key wrap (RFC 3394) with the specified key encryption key and key management algorithm.

nodes.name: unwrap
nodes.summary: Decrypts a wrapped key using AES key unwrap (RFC 3394) with the specified key encryption key and key management algorithm.

nodes.name: AESGCM.swift
nodes.summary: Provides AES-GCM authenticated encryption and decryption using Apple's CryptoKit framework. Returns ContentEncryptionContext with ciphertext, authentication tag, and initialization vector.

nodes.name: encrypt
nodes.summary: Encrypts plaintext using AES-GCM via CryptoKit with a specified symmetric key, nonce, and additional authenticated data.

nodes.name: decrypt
nodes.summary: Decrypts AES-GCM ciphertext using CryptoKit with a specified symmetric key, nonce, authentication tag, and additional authenticated data.

nodes.name: EC.swift
nodes.summary: Implements elliptic curve cryptographic operations including ECDSA signing/verification with ASN.1-to-raw signature conversion, ECDH key agreement with optional key wrapping, and EC-based JWE encryption/decryption context generation.

nodes.name: sign
nodes.summary: Signs data using ECDSA with the specified private key and algorithm, converting the DER-encoded signature to raw JWS format via ASN.1 parsing.

nodes.name: verify
nodes.summary: Verifies an ECDSA signature against input data by converting the raw JWS signature back to DER-encoded ASN.1 format before calling SecKeyVerifySignature.

nodes.name: encryptionContextFor
nodes.summary: Generates an EC-based JWE encryption context by performing ECDH key agreement with an ephemeral key pair, optionally wrapping the content encryption key with AES key wrap.

nodes.name: decrypt
nodes.summary: Decrypts an EC-encrypted JWE key by performing ECDH key agreement with the ephemeral public key from the header and optionally unwrapping with AES key unwrap.

nodes.name: ECDHKeyAgreement.swift
nodes.summary: Implements ECDH key agreement with Concat KDF (RFC 7518 Section 4.6.2) for deriving key encryption keys. Also provides SHA-2 hash digest and HMAC utilities, plus helper functions for byte manipulation.

nodes.name: keyAgreementCompute
nodes.summary: Computes an ECDH key agreement result by deriving shared secret bits and running them through the Concat KDF with algorithm, party info, and key length parameters per NIST 800-56A.

nodes.name: concatKDF
nodes.summary: Implements the Concat KDF key derivation function from RFC 7518 Section 4.6.2, iteratively hashing concatenated inputs with a counter to produce derived keying material.

nodes.name: HMAC.swift
nodes.summary: Calculates HMAC-SHA256/384/512 message authentication codes using Apple's CommonCrypto framework. Maps HMACAlgorithm to CCAlgorithm and CCPseudoRandomAlgorithm values.

nodes.name: calculate
nodes.summary: Computes an HMAC over the given input data with the specified key and HMAC algorithm using CommonCrypto's CCHmac function.

nodes.name: PBES2.swift
nodes.summary: Implements PBES2 (Password-Based Encryption Scheme 2) key derivation using PBKDF2 with HMAC-SHA algorithms, deriving AES key wrapping keys from a password, salt, and iteration count.

nodes.name: deriveWrappingKey
nodes.summary: Derives an AES key wrapping key from a password using PBKDF2 with the specified algorithm, salt input, and iteration count via CommonCrypto's CCKeyDerivationPBKDF.

nodes.name: SecureRandom.swift
nodes.summary: Generates cryptographically secure random bytes using Apple's Security framework (SecRandomCopyBytes). Used throughout the framework for IV generation, key material, and salt creation.

nodes.name: RSA.swift
nodes.summary: Implements RSA cryptographic operations including signing (PKCS1 v1.5 and PSS), verification, encryption, and decryption using Apple's Security framework SecKey APIs. Includes plaintext and ciphertext length validation.

nodes.name: sign
nodes.summary: Signs data using RSA with the specified private key and signature algorithm (RS256/384/512 or PS256/384/512) via SecKeyCreateSignature.

nodes.name: verify
nodes.summary: Verifies an RSA signature against input data using the specified public key and signature algorithm via SecKeyVerifySignature.

nodes.name: encrypt
nodes.summary: Encrypts plaintext using RSA with the specified public key and key management algorithm (RSA1_5, RSA-OAEP, RSA-OAEP-256) via SecKeyCreateEncryptedData.

nodes.name: decrypt
nodes.summary: Decrypts RSA ciphertext using the specified private key and key management algorithm via SecKeyCreateDecryptedData.

nodes.name: Thumbprint.swift
nodes.summary: Computes JWK thumbprint hashes (SHA-256) using CommonCrypto, returning the result as a Base64URL-encoded string. Used for JWK identification and key matching per RFC 7638.

nodes.name: Compressor.swift
nodes.summary: Defines the CompressorProtocol and CompressorFactory for JWE content compression. Supports DEFLATE and NONE (passthrough) algorithms, creating the appropriate compressor implementation at runtime.

nodes.name: DeflateWrapper.swift
nodes.summary: Implements zlib DEFLATE compression and decompression using Apple's Compression framework for JWE content encoding. Based on the DataCompression library with a streaming compression approach.

nodes.name: compress
nodes.summary: Compresses data using zlib DEFLATE encoding (RFC 1951) at compression level 5, delegating to the private perform streaming compression function.

nodes.name: decompress
nodes.summary: Decompresses DEFLATE-compressed data using zlib decoding, delegating to the private perform streaming decompression function.

nodes.name: ContentEncryption.swift
nodes.summary: Defines ContentEncrypter and ContentDecrypter protocols and factory methods on ContentEncryptionAlgorithm to create the appropriate encrypter/decrypter implementation (AES-CBC or AES-GCM) based on the algorithm type.

nodes.name: AESCBCEncryption.swift
nodes.summary: Implements AES-CBC content encryption and decryption with HMAC-based authentication for JWE, conforming to ContentEncrypter and ContentDecrypter protocols. Handles key splitting, IV generation, HMAC tag computation, and constant-time tag verification.

nodes.name: encrypt
nodes.summary: Encrypts plaintext using AES-CBC with HMAC authentication: splits the content encryption key into HMAC and encryption keys, generates a random IV, computes the authentication tag over the AAD.

nodes.name: decrypt
nodes.summary: Decrypts AES-CBC encrypted content by verifying the HMAC authentication tag in constant time before decrypting the ciphertext with the split content encryption key.

nodes.name: AESGCMEncryption.swift
nodes.summary: Implements AES-GCM content encryption and decryption for JWE, conforming to ContentEncrypter and ContentDecrypter protocols. Delegates to the AESGCM crypto primitive with random IV generation.

nodes.name: Decrypter.swift
nodes.summary: JWE decrypter that orchestrates key management mode decryption with content decryption, validating algorithm headers match before unwrapping the content encryption key and decrypting the ciphertext.

nodes.name: Encrypter.swift
nodes.summary: JWE encrypter that orchestrates key management mode encryption with content encryption, validating algorithm headers match before determining the content encryption key and encrypting the payload.

nodes.name: JWE.swift
nodes.summary: Core JWE (JSON Web Encryption) implementation per RFC 7516, supporting construction from header/payload/encrypter, compact serialization/deserialization, and decryption with optional compression handling.

nodes.name: init(header:payload:encrypter:)
nodes.summary: Constructs a JWE by compressing the payload and encrypting it with the provided encrypter, storing the resulting header, encrypted key, ciphertext, IV, and authentication tag.

nodes.name: decrypt
nodes.summary: Decrypts the JWE ciphertext using the provided decrypter and decompresses the result using the header's compression algorithm, returning the plaintext payload.

nodes.name: JWEHeader.swift
nodes.summary: Defines the JWEHeader struct conforming to JOSEHeader, representing the header of a JWE (JSON Web Encryption) object. It manages header parameters including key management algorithm, content encryption algorithm, compression, and ECDH/PBES2 agreement parameters, with full JSON serialization support.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Swift property observers (didSet) to re-serialize header data when parameters change, and provides multiple convenience initializers for different JWE use cases.

nodes.name: AESKeyWrappingMode.swift
nodes.summary: Implements AES Key Wrapping as a key management mode for JWE, conforming to both EncryptionKeyManagementMode and DecryptionKeyManagementMode. It generates a random content encryption key, wraps it with a shared symmetric key using AES, and unwraps it on the decryption side.

nodes.name: DirectEncryptionMode.swift
nodes.summary: Implements direct encryption key management for JWE, where a pre-shared symmetric key is used directly as the content encryption key. The encrypted key is always empty per the JWE specification for direct encryption.

nodes.name: ECKeyEncryption.swift
nodes.summary: Implements ECDH-based key agreement and key wrapping for JWE encryption and decryption. The EncryptionMode generates an ephemeral EC key pair and derives a shared key, while DecryptionMode recovers the content encryption key using the recipient's private key with MMA attack mitigation.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a nested enum pattern (ECKeyEncryption.EncryptionMode / DecryptionMode) to namespace the two related but distinct key management strategies.

nodes.name: PBES2KeyEncryptionMode.swift
nodes.summary: Implements PBES2 (Password-Based Encryption Scheme 2) key management for JWE, deriving a wrapping key from a password using salt and iteration count parameters. Supports both encryption (generating random salt and CEK) and decryption (reading salt/iteration count from the header).

nodes.name: RSAKeyEncryptionMode.swift
nodes.summary: Implements RSA-based key encryption for JWE, where a randomly generated content encryption key is encrypted with the recipient's RSA public key. Decryption includes Million Message Attack (MMA) mitigation by returning a random key on decryption failure.
nodes.languageNotes: MMA (Million Message Attack) mitigation follows RFC-3218 and RFC-5246 guidance, substituting a random CEK when RSA decryption fails to prevent timing-based oracle attacks.

nodes.name: KeyManagementMode.swift
nodes.summary: Defines the core EncryptionKeyManagementMode and DecryptionKeyManagementMode protocols and provides a factory method on KeyManagementAlgorithm that dispatches to concrete implementations (RSA, AES-KW, Direct, ECDH, PBES2) based on the algorithm type. Includes runtime type casting to match key types with management modes.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a private generic cast function to work around Swift's limitation where conditional downcasts to CoreFoundation SecKey types always succeed, requiring runtime type checks instead.

nodes.name: DataECPrivateKey.swift
nodes.summary: Extends Data to conform to ExpressibleAsECPrivateKeyComponents, providing serialization and parsing of EC private keys in uncompressed ANSI X9.63 format (04 || x || y || d). Validates curve point octet lengths during conversion.

nodes.name: DataECPublicKey.swift
nodes.summary: Extends Data to conform to ExpressibleAsECPublicKeyComponents, providing serialization and parsing of EC public keys in uncompressed format (04 || x || y). Validates that x and y coordinates are equal length and match a known curve.

nodes.name: ECKeyCodable.swift
nodes.summary: Provides Encodable and Decodable conformance for ECPublicKey and ECPrivateKey, handling the serialization of common JWK parameters alongside EC-specific parameters (crv, x, y, and optionally d for private keys).

nodes.name: ECKeyPair.swift
nodes.summary: Provides convenience methods for EC key pair generation via SecKeyCreateRandomKey, public key extraction from a private key, and key correspondence verification between an ECPrivateKey and ECPublicKey.

nodes.name: ECKeys.swift
nodes.summary: Core EC JWK implementation defining the ExpressibleAsECPublicKeyComponents and ExpressibleAsECPrivateKeyComponents protocols, plus the ECPublicKey and ECPrivateKey structs conforming to the JWK protocol. Supports initialization from components, JSON data, and conversion to native key representations with thumbprint computation.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses typealiases for component tuples (ECPublicKeyComponents, ECPrivateKeyComponents) and the ECKeyPair typealias pointing to ECPrivateKey, following the pattern where a private key inherently contains public key data.

nodes.name: SecKeyECPrivateKey.swift
nodes.summary: Extends SecKey to conform to ExpressibleAsECPrivateKeyComponents, enabling conversion between JWK EC private key components and Apple Security framework SecKey objects via SecKeyCreateWithData and SecKeyCopyExternalRepresentation.

nodes.name: SecKeyECPublicKey.swift
nodes.summary: Extends SecKey to conform to ExpressibleAsECPublicKeyComponents, enabling conversion between JWK EC public key components and Apple Security framework SecKey objects via SecKeyCreateWithData and SecKeyCopyExternalRepresentation.

nodes.name: JWK.swift
nodes.summary: Defines the JWK protocol that all key types (RSA, EC, Symmetric) conform to, specifying key type, parameters, JSON serialization, thumbprint computation, and thumbprint-as-key-id functionality. Also defines JWKKeyType enum and internal JWKError.

nodes.name: JWKExtensions.swift
nodes.summary: Provides convenience extensions on the JWK protocol for parameter subscript access, JSON string encoding, and JSON data encoding using sorted keys for deterministic output.

nodes.name: JWKParameters.swift
nodes.summary: Defines CodingKey enums for all JWK parameter types: common JWK parameters (kty, use, kid, etc.), RSA-specific (n, e, d), EC-specific (crv, x, y, d), and Symmetric-specific (k), mapping directly to their JSON key names per the JOSE RFCs.

nodes.name: JWKSet.swift
nodes.summary: Defines the JWKSet struct representing a collection of JWK keys, conforming to Collection and ExpressibleByArrayLiteral for idiomatic Swift usage. Provides JSON serialization/deserialization and collection iteration over its keys array.

nodes.name: JWKSetCodable.swift
nodes.summary: Implements Encodable and Decodable conformance for JWKSet using a two-phase decoding strategy: first probe the key type and presence of private key data via JWKBase, then decode to the correct concrete JWK type (ECPublicKey, ECPrivateKey, RSAPublicKey, RSAPrivateKey, or SymmetricKey).
nodes.languageNotes: Uses an unusual but effective pattern for polymorphic decoding: JWKBase.decode intentionally throws typed errors (JWKTypeError) to communicate the detected key type, which the caller catches to select the correct concrete decoder.

nodes.name: DataRSAPublicKey.swift
nodes.summary: Extends Data to conform to ExpressibleAsRSAPublicKeyComponents, converting between RSA public key components (modulus, exponent) and DER-encoded PKCS#1 representation using ASN.1 integer and sequence encoding.

nodes.name: RSAKeyCodable.swift
nodes.summary: Provides Encodable and Decodable conformance for RSAPublicKey and RSAPrivateKey, handling the serialization of common JWK parameters alongside RSA-specific parameters (modulus n, exponent e, and optionally private exponent d).

nodes.name: RSAKeys.swift
nodes.summary: Core RSA JWK implementation defining the ExpressibleAsRSAPublicKeyComponents and ExpressibleAsRSAPrivateKeyComponents protocols, plus the RSAPublicKey and RSAPrivateKey structs conforming to the JWK protocol. Supports initialization from components, JSON data, conversion to native key representations, and thumbprint computation.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses typealiases for component tuples (RSAPublicKeyComponents, RSAPrivateKeyComponents) and the RSAKeyPair typealias pointing to RSAPrivateKey, following the same pattern as EC keys where a private key inherently contains public key data.

nodes.name: SecKeyRSAPublicKey.swift
nodes.summary: Extends SecKey to conform to ExpressibleAsRSAPublicKeyComponents, enabling conversion between JWK RSA public key components (modulus, exponent) and Apple Security framework SecKey objects via SecKeyCreateWithData and SecKeyCopyExternalRepresentation.

nodes.name: DataSymmetricKey.swift
nodes.summary: Extends Data to conform to ExpressibleAsSymmetricKeyComponents, providing a trivial identity conversion between Data and symmetric key components since the raw key bytes are the components themselves.

nodes.name: SymmetricKeyCodable.swift
nodes.summary: Provides Encodable and Decodable conformance for the SymmetricKey JWK type, handling the serialization of common JWK parameters alongside the symmetric key parameter (k), with base64url decoding of the key data during deserialization.

nodes.name: SymmetricKeys.swift
nodes.summary: Defines the SymmetricKey JWK type and the ExpressibleAsSymmetricKeyComponents protocol for converting symmetric keys to and from JWK representation. Supports base64url-encoded octet key material with optional additional JWK parameters.

nodes.name: ECSigner.swift
nodes.summary: Internal elliptic curve signer implementing the SignerProtocol, delegating to the EC utility for signing operations with a private key and algorithm.

nodes.name: ECVerifier.swift
nodes.summary: Internal elliptic curve verifier implementing the VerifierProtocol, delegating to the EC utility for signature verification with a public key.

nodes.name: HMACSigner.swift
nodes.summary: Internal HMAC signer implementing the SignerProtocol, computing message authentication codes using a symmetric key and the HMAC utility.

nodes.name: HMACVerifier.swift
nodes.summary: Internal HMAC verifier implementing the VerifierProtocol, verifying MACs using timing-safe comparison against a recomputed HMAC.

nodes.name: RSASigner.swift
nodes.summary: Internal RSA signer implementing the SignerProtocol, delegating to the RSA utility for signing operations with a private key.

nodes.name: RSAVerifier.swift
nodes.summary: Internal RSA verifier implementing the VerifierProtocol, delegating to the RSA utility for signature verification with a public key.

nodes.name: JWS.swift
nodes.summary: Core JWS (JSON Web Signature) implementation providing a public struct that holds a header, payload, and signature. Supports construction from components with signing, deserialization from compact serialization, signature validation, and conforms to CompactSerializable and CompactDeserializable protocols.

nodes.name: JWSHeader.swift
nodes.summary: Defines the JWSHeader struct conforming to JOSEHeader and CommonHeaderParameterSpace, managing all standard JWS header parameters including alg, jku, jwk, kid, x5u, x5c, x5t, x5tS256, typ, cty, and crit as typed accessors over a dictionary representation.

nodes.name: Signer.swift
nodes.summary: Public-facing Signer type that acts as a factory, routing signing operations to the appropriate algorithm-specific implementation (EC, RSA, or HMAC) based on the SignatureAlgorithm. Also defines the SignerProtocol and a JOSESigningInput helper extension.

nodes.name: Verifier.swift
nodes.summary: Public-facing Verifier type that acts as a factory, routing verification operations to the appropriate algorithm-specific implementation (EC, RSA, or HMAC) based on the SignatureAlgorithm. Also defines the VerifierProtocol for custom verification implementations.

nodes.name: Info.plist
nodes.summary: Framework bundle configuration for JOSESwift, declaring version 3.0.0, package type FMWK, and standard Apple bundle metadata keys.

nodes.name: JOSESwift.h
nodes.summary: Objective-C umbrella header for the JOSESwift framework, exporting version number and version string symbols for mixed-language interoperability.

nodes.name: message.txt
nodes.summary: Test fixture containing a plain-text message used as signing input in EC-256 test cases.

nodes.name: test.ec256.d.key
nodes.summary: Test fixture containing the EC P-256 private key component (d parameter) in base64url encoding.

nodes.name: test.ec256.durl.key
nodes.summary: Test fixture containing the EC P-256 private key d parameter with base64url encoding variant for URL-safe transport.

nodes.name: test.ec256.key
nodes.summary: Test fixture containing a full EC P-256 JWK key structure with public and private key components for signing test cases.

nodes.name: test.ec256.keyparam
nodes.summary: Test fixture containing EC P-256 key parameters used to verify JWK key parameter parsing and serialization.

nodes.name: test.ec256.pub.key
nodes.summary: Test fixture containing the EC P-256 public key JWK structure for verification test cases.

nodes.name: test.ec256.pub.x.key
nodes.summary: Test fixture containing the EC P-256 public key x-coordinate parameter in base64url encoding.

nodes.name: test.ec256.pub.xurl.key
nodes.summary: Test fixture containing the EC P-256 public key x-coordinate with base64url encoding variant for URL-safe transport.

nodes.name: test.ec256.pub.y.key
nodes.summary: Test fixture containing the EC P-256 public key y-coordinate parameter in base64url encoding.

nodes.name: test.ec256.pub.yurl.key
nodes.summary: Test fixture containing the EC P-256 public key y-coordinate with base64url encoding variant for URL-safe transport.

nodes.name: test.ec256.sig
nodes.summary: Test fixture containing the raw EC P-256 signature binary for verification test cases.

nodes.name: test.ec256.sig.b64
nodes.summary: Test fixture containing the base64url-encoded EC P-256 signature for JWS compact serialization test cases.

nodes.name: SymmetricKey
nodes.summary: A JWK struct representing a symmetric (octet) key, supporting initialization from raw key data or symmetric key components, JSON deserialization, and conversion to types conforming to ExpressibleAsSymmetricKeyComponents.

nodes.name: converted(to:)
nodes.summary: Converts the SymmetricKey JWK to a specified type conforming to ExpressibleAsSymmetricKeyComponents, decoding the base64url-encoded key data first.

nodes.name: withThumbprintAsKeyId(algorithm:)
nodes.summary: Returns a copy of the SymmetricKey with the JWK thumbprint set as the key identifier (kid) parameter.

nodes.name: sign(_:)
nodes.summary: Signs data using elliptic curve cryptography by delegating to the EC.sign utility.

nodes.name: verify(_:against:)
nodes.summary: Verifies an EC signature by delegating to the EC.verify utility with a public key and algorithm.

nodes.name: sign(_:)
nodes.summary: Computes an HMAC signature by delegating to the HMAC.calculate utility with a symmetric key and algorithm.

nodes.name: verify(_:against:)
nodes.summary: Verifies an HMAC signature by recomputing the MAC and comparing with timing-safe comparison to prevent side-channel attacks.

nodes.name: sign(_:)

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: JOSESwift is a modular framework implementing the JOSE standards (JWS, JWE, JWK) in Swift. The README covers the three core capabilities -- digitally signing data with JWS, encrypting data with JWE, and encoding cryptographic keys as JWK -- along with the full list of supported algorithms and installation options via CocoaPods, Carthage, and Swift Package Manager.

tour.title: Package Manifest
tour.description: The root Package.swift defines the JOSESwift library target with zero external dependencies, supporting iOS 13+, macOS 10.15+, watchOS 8+, tvOS 15+, and visionOS 1. This is the entry point for building and integrating the framework via Swift Package Manager.
tour.languageLesson: Swift Package Manager uses Package.swift as its manifest. The .library and .target directives define what gets built and exported. Zero external dependencies means the framework relies solely on Apple's built-in frameworks (Security, CommonCrypto, CryptoKit) for all cryptographic operations.

tour.title: Common Foundations
tour.description: The Common layer establishes the shared vocabulary used across all three JOSE standards. Algorithms.swift defines every supported algorithm as typed enums, DataConvertible provides the bidirectional Data serialization protocol that underpins all JOSE component encoding, and JOSEHeader defines the header protocol shared by JWS and JWE objects. These files are the most widely imported in the entire framework.
tour.languageLesson: Swift protocols with associated types (like DataConvertible) enable type-safe serialization without runtime casting. Combined with enum-based algorithm definitions, the framework achieves exhaustive switch-case coverage -- the compiler will error if a new algorithm is added to the enum but not handled in every switch statement.

tour.title: Serialization and Data Utilities
tour.description: Serializer and Deserializer handle the compact JOSE wire format -- dot-separated, Base64URL-encoded strings. DataExtensions provides the Base64URL encoding/decoding, constant-time comparison for cryptographic safety, and other byte manipulation helpers. Together these files form the I/O layer that translates between in-memory JOSE objects and their string representations.

tour.title: Crypto Primitives
tour.description: The CryptoPrimitives directory wraps Apple's Security framework, CommonCrypto, and CryptoKit into a clean internal API. RSA.swift handles signing and encryption with SecKey, AES.swift provides CBC and key-wrap operations via CommonCrypto, EC.swift implements ECDSA and ECDH, and SecureRandom.swift generates cryptographically random bytes. These modules are the sole bridge to platform cryptography -- the rest of the framework never calls Apple APIs directly.
tour.languageLesson: JOSESwift uses Apple's Security framework (SecKey APIs) rather than OpenSSL, ensuring the framework has no transitive C dependency and can ship on all Apple platforms. CryptoKit (introduced in iOS 13) is used specifically for AES-GCM, while CommonCrypto covers AES-CBC and HMAC.

tour.title: JWS: Signing and Verification
tour.description: The JWS module implements JSON Web Signatures per RFC 7515. JWS.swift is the public-facing struct that holds header, payload, and signature. Signer.swift and Verifier.swift act as factories routing to algorithm-specific implementations (EC, RSA, or HMAC) based on the SignatureAlgorithm enum. JWSHeader manages the header parameters including the required alg field.
tour.languageLesson: The Signer and Verifier use a factory pattern combined with protocol-based polymorphism: SignerProtocol and VerifierProtocol define the contract, while concrete implementations (ECSigner, RSASigner, HMACSigner) handle algorithm-specific details. This lets users add custom signers by conforming to the protocol.

tour.title: JWE: Encryption and Decryption
tour.description: The JWE module implements JSON Web Encryption per RFC 7516. JWE.swift is the core struct supporting construction with an encrypter and decryption with a decrypter. Encrypter.swift and Decrypter.swift orchestrate two layers: a key management mode that establishes the content encryption key, and a content encryption mode that encrypts the payload. JWEHeader manages encryption-specific parameters like the enc and zip fields.

tour.title: JWE Key Management Modes
tour.description: KeyManagementMode.swift defines the protocols and a factory that dispatches to concrete implementations based on the algorithm: RSA key encryption, AES key wrapping, ECDH key agreement, PBES2 password-based encryption, and direct encryption. Each mode handles generating or recovering the content encryption key, which is then passed to the content encryption layer from Step 7.

tour.title: JWK: Key Representation
tour.description: The JWK module implements JSON Web Keys per RFC 7517. JWK.swift defines the protocol all key types conform to, with RSAKeys.swift and ECKeys.swift providing the concrete RSAPublicKey, RSAPrivateKey, ECPublicKey, and ECPrivateKey structs. JWKSet.swift represents a collection of keys with full JSON serialization. Each key type supports bidirectional conversion between JWK JSON, raw Data, and Apple SecKey objects.
tour.languageLesson: Swift protocol-oriented design shines here: the JWK protocol specifies common behavior (JSON serialization, thumbprint, key type), while each concrete type adds algorithm-specific parameters via extensions on Data and SecKey. This avoids inheritance while ensuring a uniform public API across all key types.

tour.title: Security and Error Handling
tour.description: SECURITY.md documents the framework's security posture: all cryptographic operations use Apple's Security framework exclusively, no custom crypto implementations exist in the codebase. JOSESwiftError.swift is the central error enum covering every failure mode across signing, verification, encryption, decryption, key coding, and header validation.

tour.title: CI/CD Pipeline
tour.description: The CircleCI pipeline runs on macOS M1 executors with four jobs: prepare-build for dependency caching, test via Fastlane, lint with SwiftFormat and SwiftLint, and SonarQube analysis. The Fastfile orchestrates testing, linting, version bumping, and release publishing to both CocoaPods trunk and GitHub Releases.
tour.languageLesson: Fastlane is the standard Ruby-based automation tool for iOS projects. Lanes (test, lint, release) are defined in a Fastfile and can be invoked locally or by CI. The pipeline uses macOS executors because iOS framework tests require Xcode and the iOS simulator, which only run on Apple hardware.
